entities.summary: Erling Vidkunsson (1293–1355) was the Norwegian nobleman and regent of Norway. He received the position of High Justiciar (drottsete) of the country. He was Lord of Bjarkøy and Giske and was probably the most important and wealthy Norwegian noble of his era.
